blocks.name: Tourism Hero
blocks.description: Full-screen hero section with glass navbar, animated entrance, and stats bar. Background image is a required prop.

variations.name: default
variations.description: Glass navbar, staggered hero copy entrance, bottom stats bar over a full-bleed background image.

props.name: imageSrc
props.description: Path or URL for the full-bleed background image

props.name: imageAlt
props.description: Alt text for the background image

props.name: heading
props.description: Hero headline. Use \n for line breaks.

props.name: subheading
props.default: Discover alpine trails, mountain refuges, and guided expeditions across the Dolomites.
props.description: Supporting body text below the headline

props.name: primaryCtaLabel
props.description: Label for the primary CTA button

props.name: secondaryCtaLabel
props.description: Label for the ghost/outline CTA button

props.name: stats
props.default: [{ value: '240+', label: 'Trails Mapped' }, { value: '48', label: 'Mountain Huts' }, { value: '12K+', label: 'Trekkers Joined Us' }]
props.description: Array of { value, label } objects rendered in the stats bar

props.name: navbarProps
props.description: Optional overrides for the glass navbar: logoText, logoIcon, navLinks, ctaLabel, onCtaClick

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes on the root wrapper
